title: 第40章 小区群传疯了
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 物业管家身后，还站着站了好几个人。男的西装革履，女的珠光宝气，中间站着个矮矮的小豆丁——正是昨晚被她从绑匪手里抢回来的那个小男孩。而门外的小区道上，整整齐齐停着四五辆豪车，黑色的大G，银色的宾利，还有一辆低调但一看就贵的迈巴赫。温栩栩眨了眨眼。这是什么阵仗？那个小豆丁一看见她，眼睛瞬间亮了，扯着嗓子喊：“爸妈！就是这个姐姐！昨天救我的那个！超级厉害！能打十个！！”小男孩的妈妈眼眶一下子就红了，上前一步，握住温栩栩的手：“温大师，真的是您……我们一大早就过来了，又怕打扰您休息，一直在这边候着。”她说着，回头看了一眼那几辆豪车，语气里带着几分不好意思：“也不知道您喜欢什么，就随便带了些东西……不成敬意。”温栩栩顺着她的目光看过去——几个司机正从后备箱往下搬东西。成箱的进口水果、一看就价值不菲的礼盒、还有一束比她人还高的鲜花。温栩栩：“……”她忽然明白那些豪车是干嘛的了。送谢礼的。她还没来得及开口，余光瞥见旁边那群人——那些站在自家门口、面带仰慕、眼神激动地往这边张望的邻居们。温栩栩指着那群人，一脸茫然地问小男孩的妈妈：“那……那些人是谁？”女人回头看了一眼，掩嘴笑了：“温大侠，您还不知道吧？昨晚的事在咱们青林湾业主群里传疯了。”“武林高手入住青林湾，一个人挑了八个持刀绑匪，还穿着睡衣拖鞋——”她顿了顿，语气里带着几分与有荣焉：“您现在可是咱们青林湾别墅区的传说。”温栩栩：“……”传说什么鬼？旁边那群人见温栩栩看过来，立刻热情地涌上前：“温大侠！我是您隔壁19栋的，这是燕窝，您收下！”“温大侠，这是黄金手镯，小小心意，不成敬意，您一定收着！”“温大侠，以后有什么困难尽管开口！咱们这片儿谁有事儿您说话！”“对对对！您可千万别搬走啊！您住这儿，咱们这片儿都踏实！”温栩栩被塞了满怀的礼盒，整个人都是懵的。“我……我不住这儿我去哪儿……”话还没说完，温栩栩就感觉自已的嘴已经被大圣接管了，大圣理直气壮的朝门口来拜访的众人一挥手：“你们有什么好吃的好玩的，都给俺上供来！”温栩栩一僵，大圣上线了。“俺爱吃桃子！”话音刚落，人群里一个中年男人立刻举手：“哎呀！温大侠爱吃桃子？我是做水果生意的，家里正好有一片桃园，孝敬给您，您什么时候想去，随时说！”另一个贵妇抢着说：“温大侠，我老公是开连锁餐厅的，您想吃什么随便点，直接送上门！”“温大侠，我这儿有最好的茶叶，您尝尝？”“温大侠……”温栩栩站在人群中央，怀里抱着燕窝、金镯子、进口水果，还有一束比她还高的鲜花，整个人都是麻的。耳边此起彼伏的“温大侠”“温女侠”，喊得她脑仁儿疼。温栩栩刚想开口客气两句，嘴巴就不听使唤了——“心意送到了就行。”大圣又开始控制她的嘴了，毫不客气道：“人就不用进来了，礼物放下，都回吧！”温栩栩瞪大眼睛，想阻止已经来不及了。大圣还在继续：“以后这片别墅区，俺老孙罩了！”话音刚落，人群中爆发出一阵欢呼。“太好了！有温大侠在，咱们这儿肯定平安！”“快快快，扫码进群！以后有要紧事直接在群里拜托温大侠！”“温大侠您有什么事儿直接在群里说一声，我们替您解决！”温栩栩还没反应过来，手机信息就在疯狂跳，扫码的、加好友的、拉群的，叮叮当当响成一片。等她回过神来，微信里已经多了一个群：【青林湾·温大侠后援会】群主：温栩栩。成员：87人，还在持续增加中。温栩栩盯着那个群名，眼前一黑。她赶紧在心里呐喊：【大圣！！！您怎么还给我拉了个群！！！】大圣理直气壮：“方便他们给我送桃子。”温栩栩：“……”行，您说得对。她正想说什么，忽然想起一件事，心里咯噔一下：【大圣，您还有半天就附身结束了……您夸下海口罩着这片，我怎么办？！】大圣嘿嘿一笑，语气里带着点“早就给你想好了”的得意：“所以啊，你以后得好好跟俺老孙练功夫。”“等俺老孙走了，你自已也能打——这不就罩住了？”温栩栩抬头看了一眼面前那群还在热情扫码的邻居们，又低头看了一眼手机上那个“温大侠后援会”的群。深吸一口气。行吧，自已夸的海口，自已圆。人群渐渐散去，礼物堆满了温栩栩的玄关。她刚松了口气，一转身，发现那对豪门父母还站在门口，小男孩被保姆先带回了车上。男人上前一步，郑重其事地递上一张名片：“温小姐，刚才那些都是薄礼，不成敬意。”温栩栩低头一看——名片上印着烫金的字：金氏集团董事长金振业她眨了眨眼。女人在旁边接话，语气诚恳得让人没法拒绝：“您救了我们家可可，就是我们全家的恩人。这点心意，您一定要收下。”温栩栩刚想开口客套一下，打下太极，男人已经从公文包里掏出一份文件，递到她面前。“这是我们金氏集团旗下的产业，您看看，对哪家感兴趣，我们送您公司股份。”
content_en: There were several people standing behind the property manager.The man was wearing a suit and leather shoes, the woman was wearing jewellery, and in the middle stood a short little boy - the little boy she snatched back from the kidnapper last night.On the community road outside the door, there were four or five luxury cars parked neatly, including a black big G, a silver Bentley, and a low-key but expensive-looking Maybach.Wen Xuxu blinked.What kind of battle is this?As soon as the little boy saw her, his eyes lit up and he shouted at the top of his lungs: "Mom and Dad! This is the sister! The one who saved me yesterday! Super powerful! Can beat ten!!" The little boy's mother's eyes suddenly turned red. She stepped forward and held Wen Xuxu's hand: "Master Wen, it's really you... We came here early in the morning., I'm afraid of disturbing your rest, so I've been waiting here." She said, looking back at the luxury cars, with a bit of embarrassment in her tone: "I don't know what you like, so I just brought something... It's not respectful." Wen Xuxu followed her gaze and looked over - several drivers were moving things down from the trunk.There were boxes of imported fruits, gift boxes that looked very valuable, and a bouquet of flowers that was taller than her.Wen Xuxu: "..." She suddenly understood what those luxury cars were for.Sending a thank you gift.Before she could speak, she caught a glimpse of the group of people next to her from the corner of her eye - the neighbors standing at the door of their homes, looking here with admiration and excited eyes.Wen Xuxu pointed at the group of people and asked the little boy's mother with a confused expression: "Then... who are those people?" The woman looked back, covered her mouth and smiled: "Master Wen, you don't know, do you? What happened last night has gone viral among our Qinglin Bay owners." "WuMaster Lin moved into Qinglin Bay and picked out eight knife-wielding kidnappers, all wearing pajamas and slippers -" She paused, with a hint of pride in her tone: "You are now the legend of our Qinglin Bay villa area" Wen Xuxu: "..." What the hell is the legend?When the group of people next to them saw Wen Xuxu looking over, they immediately rushed forward enthusiastically: "Master Wen! I'm from the 19th building next door to you. This is a bird's nest. Please accept it!" "Master Wen, this is a gold bracelet. It's too small and disrespectful. You must keep it!" "WenHero, if you have any problems in the future, just ask!"If anyone in our area has anything to do with it, please don't move away! We are all safe here!"Wen Xuxu was filled with gift boxes and was completely confused."I...I don't live here, where should I go..." Before he could finish his words, Wen Xuxu felt that his mouth had been taken over by the Great Sage. The Great Sage confidently waved his hand to the people who came to visit at the door: "If you have anything delicious and fun, please bring it to me!" Wen Xuxu froze, and the Great Sage came online."I love to eat peaches!" As soon as he finished speaking, a middle-aged man in the crowd immediately raised his hand: "Oh! Master Wen loves to eat peaches? I'm in the fruit business, and I happen to have a peach orchard at home, so I'd like to give it to you. If you want to go, just let me know at any time!" Another lady rushed to say, "Master Wen, my husband is a foreigner.From a chain restaurant, you can order whatever you want and have it delivered directly to your door!""Master Wen, I have the best tea here, would you like to try it?" "Master Wen..." Wen Xuxu stood in the middle of the crowd, holding a bird's nest, a gold bracelet, imported fruits, and a bouquet of flowers that were taller than her. Her whole body was numb.The words "Master Wen" and "Nvxia Wen" kept ringing in her ears, making her brain hurt.Wen Xuxu was just about to say a few polite words, but her mouth stopped obeying her - "As long as you send me your thoughts." The Great Sage began to control her mouth again, and said unceremoniously: "There is no need for people to come in. Put down the gifts and return them all!" Wen Xuxu's eyes widened, and it was too late to stop her.The Great Sage continued: "From now on, I will cover this villa area!" As soon as he finished speaking, a burst of cheers broke out from the crowd."Great! With Master Wen here, we will definitely be safe here!" "Quickly, quickly, scan the QR code to join the group! If you have any important matters in the future, please ask Master Wen directly in the group!" "Master Wen, if you have any questions, just tell us in the group and we will solve it for you!" Before Wen Xuxu could react, the messages on his phone were jumping like crazy. People who were scanning the QR code, adding friends, and joining the group were buzzing.When she came to her senses, there was already a group in WeChat: [Qinglin Bay·Wen Daxia Support Club] The group leader: Wen Xuxu.Members: 87 and counting.Wen Xuxu stared at the group name and his vision went dark.She quickly shouted in her heart: [Great Sage!!!Why did you even create a group for me?!!】The Great Sage said confidently: "It's convenient for them to give me peaches." Wen Xuxu: "..." OK, you are right.She was about to say something when she suddenly remembered something and her heart skipped a beat: [Great Sage, your possession will end in half a day... You boasted about wearing this mask, what should I do?!】 The great sage chuckled, with a hint of "I have already thought of it for you" in his tone: "So, you have to practice kung fu with me in the future." "When I am gone, you can fight on your own - doesn't this cover you?" Wen Xuxu looked up at the group of neighbors in front of him who were still enthusiastically scanning the QR code, and then looked down at the "Master Wen Support Club" group on his phone.Take a deep breath.Okay, let's make the boast of Haikou perfect by ourselves.The crowd gradually dispersed, and Wen Xuxu's entrance was filled with gifts.She just breathed a sigh of relief, turned around, and found that the wealthy parents were still standing at the door, and the little boy was taken back to the car by the nanny.The man took a step forward and handed over a business card solemnly: "Ms. Wen, those were just small gifts and not respectful." Wen Xuxu lowered her head and looked - there were gilded words on the business card: Jin Zhenye, Chairman of the Jin Group. She blinked.The woman answered next to her, her tone so sincere that no one could refuse: "You saved our family Coco, and you are the benefactor of our family. You must accept this kindness." Just when Wen Xuxu was about to be polite and put down Tai Chi, the man had already taken out a document from his briefcase and handed it to her."This is an industry under our Jin Group. Take a look and see which one you are interested in. We will give you company shares."
